programme.desc: 1958. Thriller. Director: Ralph Kemplen. Stars Tony Wright, Lee Patterson, Michael Hordern & Susan Beaumont. A man of Spanish heritage is convicted of murder & places a curse on the judge & jury.

programme.title: Whiplash
programme.desc: Convict Town. 1960. Stars Peter Graves, Anthony Wickert & Alex Cann. Big Tom is determined to stop Chris Cobb from opening a new stage route.

programme.title: The Man from U.N.C.L.E
programme.desc: The Giuoco Piano Affair. 1964. Stars Robert Vaughn, David McCallum & Leo G. Carroll. Solo and Kuryakin pursue the only surviving conspirators of The Quadripartite Affair.

programme.title: Francis Durbridge's The Passenger
programme.desc: The Passenger Part One. 1971. Stars Peter Barkworth, Joanna Dunham & Arthur Pentelow. Businessman David Walker picks up a hitcher, and his personal and professional problems get a whole lot worse.

programme.title: Turn The Key Softly
programme.desc: 1953. Drama. Director: Jack Lee. Stars Yvonne Mitchell, Joan Collins, Kathleen Harrison. Three women are released from Holloway prison on the same morning into the bustle of post-war London.

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: Caroline Munro takes us on a trip to Prague in tonight's enthralling feature Czech Mate; a mystifying tale about a woman who is betrayed and forced into the world of espionage and murder.

programme.title: Hammer House of Mystery and Suspense
programme.desc: Czech Mate. 1984. Stars Susan George, Patrick Mower & Peter Vaughan. Vicky goes to Prague with her ex-husband but soon finds herself alone, penniless and caught up in a murder.

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: Get ready for another night full of terror as Caroline Munro introduces next week's spine tingling tale from the Hammer House of Mystery and Suspense collection.

programme.title: The Curse of the Wraydons
programme.desc: 1946. Horror. A young captain, after participating in a duel, becomes the suspect in a series of killings near Epping Forest. Directed by Victor M Gover. Starring Tod Slaughter & Bruce Seton.

programme.title: Cabin Boy
programme.desc: 1994. Comedy. Director: Adam Resnick. Stars Chris Elliott, Ritch Brinkley & Brian Doyle-Murray. An arrogant young man plans to go on a Hawaiian cruise, but winds up lost at sea on a fishing boat.

programme.title: Look At Life Ark in the Sky
programme.desc: 1967. A look at the remarkable livestock traffic passing through Heathrow Airport, which are cared for by the RSPCA.

programme.title: Target: The Corruptors
programme.desc: The Poppy Vendor. 1961. Stars Stephen McNally, Robert Harland & Harold J. Stone. Marino visits an ex-con who's wife is an addict, he wants to go back to his old ways to catch the criminals.

programme.title: The David Niven Show
programme.desc: The Lady from Winnetka. Jacques Bergerac, Argentina Brunetti & Eduardo Ciannelli. British actor David Niven, introduces this 1950s US anthology series. (S1, E07)

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
programme.desc: Lafe Returns. 1964. Stars Buddy Ebsen, Peter Whitney & Bobs Watson. Still trying to get his hands on the Clampett millions, Lafe pays a return visit to try to find where Jed has buried his money.

programme.title: Singing Through
programme.desc: 1935. Comedy. Directed by Max Mack. Stars Bobbie Comber, Bertha Belmore & Cecil Ramage. A rural man is duped into schemes that lead him to London.

programme.title: A Tale of Five Cities
programme.desc: 1951. Drama. Stars Bonar Colleano, Barbara Kelly, Eva Bartok & Gina Lollobrigida. An Englishman leaves America to enlist in the RAF, but a drunken accident results in a loss of memory.

programme.title: Four Star Playhouse: Interlude
programme.desc: 1954. Stars Dick Powell and Joanne Woodward. A magazine correspondent befriends a young girl ahead of her graduation day.

programme.title: Gallant Journey
programme.desc: 1946. Drama. Directed by William A. Wellman. Stars Glenn Ford, Janet Blair & Charlie Ruggles. Biopic of US aviation pioneer John J. Montgomery who battled the odds to build a successful glider.

programme.title: Look At Life Putting Up a Show
programme.desc: 1967. A captivating look into the complex organisation of exhibition display, featuring the exhibition halls of Earls Court and Olympia, which draw hundreds of thousands of people to every show.

programme.title: The Ghost Goes West
programme.desc: 1935. Comedy. Directed by René Clair. Stars Robert Donat, Jean Parker & Elsa Lanchester. A haunted Scottish castle is sold, dismantled and transported to Florida, bringing the ghost along with it.

programme.title: Miranda
programme.desc: 1948. Comedy. Director: Ken Annakin. Stars: Glynis Johns, Googie Withers, Margaret Rutherford. A light comedy about a beautiful and playful mermaid and her effect on Dr. Paul Martin.

programme.title: The Brothers
programme.desc: Ripples. 1976. Stars Jean Anderson, Patrick O'Connell & Amanda Boxer. Gwen and the brothers detect something bothering Mary. Meanwhile, Jennifer's outburst has unforeseen consequences.

programme.title: Dial 999
programme.desc: Escape. 1958. Stars Robert Beatty, Jack Lambert & Harry Towmb. Following a tip-off, Bill Killian is caught opening a safe. His brother helps him escape but the police are hot on their trail.

programme.title: The Disappearance of Flight 412
programme.desc: 1974. Sci-fi. Directed by Jud Taylor. Stars Glenn Ford & Bradford Dillman. When Flight 412 witnesses the disappearance of two fighter jets, a military group attempts to cover up the incident.

programme.title: The Trollenberg Terror
programme.desc: 1958. Sci-Fi. A series of deaths on a Swiss mountain-side appear to be connected to a mysterious cloud. Stars: Forrest Tucker, Warren Mitchell & Andrew Faulds.

programme.title: Look At Life The Straits of Dover
programme.desc: 1967. A close look at the 750 ships that pass through the five mile wide shipping channel every day.

programme.title: Scotland Yard
programme.desc: 1957. Bullet from the Past. Director: Kenneth Hume. Stars Ballard Berkeley, Robert Sansom and Philippa Hyatt. An inspector investigates the shooting of a man connected to an old cold case. (S1, E20)

programme.title: Van der Valk
programme.desc: Proof of Life. Stars Barry Foster, Meg Davies & Ronald Hines. When a businessman and his son are kidnapped, Van der Valk must establish whether the man's wife is involved.

programme.title: The Key
programme.desc: 1958. War. Director: Carol Reed. Stars William Holden, Sophia Loren, Trevor Howard. A tugboat captain working off the coast of England finds comfort in the arms of the caring and beautiful Stella.

programme.title: Nights of Cabiria
programme.desc: 1957. Drama. Director: Federico Fellini. Stars Giulietta, Francois Perier & Franca Marzi. A waifish prostitute only finds heartbreak while wandering the streets of Rome in search for love.

programme.title: The Return of October
programme.desc: 1948. Comedy. Director: Joseph H. Lewis. Stars Glenn Ford, Terry Moore & Albert Sharpe. A young woman must prove her sanity after claiming that a racehorse is the reincarnation of her late uncle.

programme.title: Naked Fury
programme.desc: 1959. After a robbery during which the night-watchman is killed, the robbers take his daughter hostage. Stars Kenneth Cope & Reed de Rouen.

programme.title: Black Saddle
programme.desc: 1959. The Freebooters. Western with Peter Breck. After his brothers are killed in a shootout, a gunfighter decides to hang up his guns and uphold the law by becoming a lawyer.

programme.title: Cause For Alarm!
programme.desc: 1951. Drama. Director: Tay Garnett. Stars Loretta Young, Barry Sullivan & Bruce Cowling. An unwell man accuses his wife and doctor of plotting to kill him, causing trouble after his sudden death.

programme.title: Meet Simon Cherry
programme.desc: 1949. Mystery. Directed by Godfrey Grayson. Stars Hugh Moxey & Jeannette Tregarthen. A reverend takes refuge at a manor house after getting lost and unexpectedly becomes involved in a murder case.

programme.title: Just William's Luck
programme.desc: 1948. Comedy. Director: Val Guest. Stars: William Graham, Garry Marsh, Jane Welsh. Based on the popular books written by Richmal Crompton.

programme.title: Design for Loving
programme.desc: 1962. Comedy. Director: Godfrey Grayson. Stars June Thorburn, Pete Murray & Soraya Rafat. Barbara Winters hires beatnik Stanford as her chief fashion adviser which leads to comedic complications.

programme.title: Della
programme.desc: 1964. Directed by Robert Gist and starring Joan Crawford. Della (Crawford), a reclusive, wealthy matriarch of Royal Bay, watches over the affluent coastal town. Possession, for her, is everything.

programme.title: Lunch Hour
programme.desc: 1961. Comedy. Shirley Anne Field gives a great performance as a young designer on the brink of an affair with a married executive (Robert Stephens) at the company she works for. Stars Kay Walsh.

programme.title: Crown Court
programme.desc: The Flight of the Lapwing - Part 1. 1974. Stars Richard Wilson, Ian Marter & John Barron. The pilot and only survivor of a light aircraft crash is suing a relative of one of the victims for libel.

programme.title: Crown Court
programme.desc: The Flight of the Lapwing - Part 2. 1974. Stars William Gaunt, Mary MacLeod & Christopher Benjamin. The cause of the crash was carbon monoxide, but nothing was found in the tissue of the dead.

programme.title: Crown Court
programme.desc: The Flight of the Lapwing - Part 3. 1974. Stars John Barron, Mary Macleod & William Gaunt. Mrs Simon claims she knew the pilot was prone to epileptic fits. She calls him a liar and a killer.

programme.title: Interrupted Journey
programme.desc: 1949. Thriller. Director: Daniel Birt. Stars Valerie Hobson, Richard Todd, Christine Norden & Tom Walls. John's wife appears to have been shot after her body is found in the wreckage of a crash.

programme.title: Strange But True?
programme.desc: Pilot - UFO Sightings/Reincarnation. 1993. Michael Aspel introduces stories of the unexplained; this episode looks at UFO sightings in West Yorkshire and a woman who believes she was reincarnated.

programme.title: Look At Life Gardens to Order
programme.desc: 1967. A trip to the garden centre, which are springing up all over the country to cater for gardeners.

programme.title: The Brothers
programme.desc: The Perfect Day. 1972. Stars Jean Anderson, Derek Benfield & Terence Brook. Hammond Transport appears to be ready for further expansion, that is until an unexpected crisis occurs.

programme.title: Mark Saber
programme.desc: The Corpse with a Sword. 1957. Stars Donald Gray, Diana Decker and Peter Bathurst. Tony Preem and his lover kill her husband so they can be together. Mark Saber is on hand when the body is found.

programme.title: The Wheeltappers and Shunters Social Club
programme.desc: Episode 23. 1975. Tony Christie sings 'Amarillo' and 'Old Man River'. Francis Yip sings 'Make My Life a Bit Brighter'. Terri Rogers, Alan Randall and Eddie Flanagan also star.

programme.title: Confessions of a Driving Instructor
programme.desc: 1976. Comedy. Director Norman Cohen. Stars Robin Askwith, Anthony Booth & Liz Fraser. The misadventures of Timothy Lea and his brother-in-law when they set up a driving school business.

programme.title: I Am A Camera
programme.desc: 1955. Drama. Director: Henry Cornelius. Stars Julie Harris, Laurence Harvey, Anton Diffring & Shelley Winters. An unusual friendship begins when an aspiring novelist, meets a cabaret entertainer.
